ko.title: 53건의 인터뷰, 1건의 독성 판결: 전 노동부 장관 차베스데레머에 대한 감찰 보고서의 내용

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: 오랫동안 기다려온 감찰 보고서가 로리 차베스데레머 전 노동부 장관에 대한 비위 의혹을 상세히 밝혔으며, 그녀가 사임하기 전 수개월 동안 수십 명의 현직 및 전직 직원들이 "독단적이고, 위협적이며 굴욕적"이라고 규정한 직장 문화를 묘사했습니다.

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: 노동부 감찰관실(OIG)이 발표한 이 보고서는 장관실 내부 상황에 대한 익명의 불만을 접수한 후 시작된 수개월 간의 조사를 마무리합니다.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: 차베스데레머는 4월에 장관직에서 사임했으며, 44페이지 분량의 조사 결과는 부서에 공개를 촉구했던 민주당 소속 연방 의원들의 압력에 따라 이번 주에야 공개되었습니다.

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## 조사가 진행된 방식

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: 보고서에 따르면 조사관들은 현직 및 전직 노동부 직원 53명과 다른 연방 기관의 직원 1명을 인터뷰했으며, 조사 과정의 일환으로 감시 영상 등 500개 이상의 문서, 이미지, 동영상을 검토했습니다.

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: 이번 조사는 부서 내 감독 업무를 수행하는 전직 연방 하원의원이 주도했습니다.

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: 인터뷰에 응한 이들 중 38명은 장관실 내부 분위기를 이와 비슷하게 부정적인 용어로 묘사하며, 성과 평가가 때로는 다른 직원들이 있는 앞에서 공개적으로 논의되었다고 조사관들에게 말했습니다. 일부 진술에 따르면 회의 중에 직원이 눈물을 흘린 적이 있는지 여부도 포함되었습니다.

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: 증인들은 이러한 환경이 "만연한 두려움과 고용 불안"을 조성했으며, 여러 직원이 해고 위협을 받았다고 보고했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## 보고서의 주요 혐의

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: 조사관들은 증거가 여러 뚜렷한 영역에 걸친 비위를 가리키고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: 보고서에 따르면 차베스데레머는 다음과 같은 행위를 한 혐의를 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - 부서 내 적대적인 근무 환경 조성에 기여

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - 경호원 중 한 명과 부적절한 관계를 맺음

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - 사적 여행에 정부 자원 사용을 포함하여 확립된 연방 여행 규정을 준수하지 않음

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - 노동부 사무실 내에서 또는 근무 시간 중에 여러 차례 음주

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - 부하 직원에게 자신의 개인적 이익을 위한 업무 수행 지시

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - 부서의 필수 윤리 채널을 통해 신고하지 않고 선물 수수

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: 감찰관실은 이번 조사 결과가 조사 과정에서 수집된 증인의 증언과 문서 증거의 우세에 근거한 것이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## 대응

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: 차베스데레머를 대변하는 변호인은 그녀가 "어떤 법도 위반하지 않았다"고 말하며 보고서의 결론에 반박했고, 변호인이 결과가 공개되기 전에 유포되었던 성급한 억측이라고 묘사한 부분을 비판했습니다.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: 차베스데레머는 범죄 혐의로 기소되지 않았으며, OIG 보고서는 형사 고발이라기보다는 행정적 검토입니다.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: 노동부는 조사 결과와 관련된 추가적인 징계나 법적 조치를 발표하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: 이 보고서가 검토를 위해 추가 감독 기관에 회부될지 여부는 여전히 불분명합니다.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## 이것이 중요한 이유

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: 이번 사건은 동일한 내부 조사 과정에서 두 명의 고위 참모가 사퇴하는 등 차베스데레머 재임 기간 동안 부서에서 불거진 일련의 인사 논란에 추가됩니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: 하원 및 상원 노동 위원회의 의원들은 보고서 결과에 대한 추가 브리핑을 모색할 수 있음을 시사했으며, 정부 감찰 단체들은 이 사건을 행정 기관이 자체 지도부에 대한 비위 불만을 처리하는 방식을 시험하는 시험대로 지적했습니다.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 이 보고서가 정부 최대 기관 중 한 곳의 막 뒤에서 벌어진 일에 대한 조사관들의 주장을 담은 비록 늦었지만 공식적인 회계 자료이자, 아무리 행동이 더디더라도 감찰관실이 각료급 공직자들의 공직 수행을 내부적으로 견제하는 몇 안 되는 수단 중 하나임을 상기시켜 주는 역할을 합니다.

zh.title: 53次访谈与一份有毒的裁决：劳工部前部长查韦斯-德雷默监督报告的调查结果

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: 一份备受期待的监督报告详细列出了针对前劳工部长洛里·查韦斯-德雷默的不当行为指控，描述了一种在数十名现任和前任员工在她离职前几个月被称为“有毒、恐吓和羞辱”的工作场所文化。

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: 该报告由劳工部总监察长办公室发布，为历时数月的调查画上了句号，此前总监察长办公室收到了关于部长办公室内部情况的匿名投诉。

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: 查韦斯-德雷默于4月辞去职务，在施压要求该部门公布这些内容的国会民主党人的推动下，这份44页的调查结果才于本周公开发布。

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## 调查是如何进行的

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: 报告称，作为调查的一部分，调查人员采访了53名现任和前任劳工部员工以及一名来自其他联邦机构的工作人员，并查阅了500多份文件、图片和视频，包括监控录像。

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: 该调查由一名在部门内部担任监督职能的前国会议员领导。

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: 在接受采访的人中，有38人以同样负面的词汇形容部长办公室内部的氛围，他们告诉调查人员，绩效考核有时会在其他员工面前公开讨论——根据一些说法，甚至包括员工在会议中被贬低到哭泣的情况。

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: 目击者称，这种环境助长了“广泛的恐惧和对工作不安全的担忧”，几名员工报告说他们曾受到解雇的威胁。

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## 报告指控了什么

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: 调查人员表示，证据指向多个不同领域的不当行为。

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: 根据报告，查韦斯-德雷默被指控：

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - 助长了部门内部敌对的工作环境

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - 与其安保随行人员之一进行了不当交往

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - 未能遵守既定的联邦旅行规定，包括将政府资源用于私人旅行

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - 多次在劳工部办公室或执勤期间饮酒

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - 指示下属为其个人利益执行任务

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - 未通过部门规定的道德渠道报告而接受礼物

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: 总监察长办公室表示，这些调查结果是基于调查过程中收集的大量证人证词和文件证据。

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## 各方回应

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: 代表查韦斯-德雷默的律师对报告的结论进行了反驳，称她“没有违反任何法律”，并批评了律师所描述的在调查结果公布前流传的过早猜测。

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: 查韦斯-德雷默未受到任何犯罪指控，总监察长办公室的报告是一项行政审查，而不是刑事移交。

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: 劳工部尚未宣布任何与调查结果相关的进一步纪律或法律行动。

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: 目前尚不清楚该报告是否会被移交给任何其他监督机构进行审查。

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么重要

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: 这一事件增添了查韦斯-德雷默任职期间在部门内浮出水面的一系列人事争议，包括在同一内部调查期间两名高级助手的早期离职。

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: 众议院和参议院劳工委员会的议员已经表示，他们可能会寻求关于报告调查结果的更多简报，政府监督组织已将此案作为测试行政机构如何处理针对其自身领导层的不当行为投诉的一个试金石。

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: 就目前而言，这份报告是对调查人员所称政府最大机构之一闭门造车事件的一份正式（尽管迟到）的说明，也是对总监察长办公室（无论行动多么缓慢）仍然是内阁级官员如何履行职务的少数内部制衡机制之一的提醒。

hi.title: 53 साक्षात्कार, एक विषाक्त फैसला: पूर्व श्रम सचिव शावेज़-डेरेमर पर वॉचडॉग रिपोर्ट में क्या पाया गया

segments.tr: लंबे समय से प्रतीक्षित एक वॉचडॉग रिपोर्ट ने पूर्व श्रम सचिव लोरी शावेज़-डेरेमर के खिलाफ कदाचार के आरोपों का विस्तृत विवरण प्रस्तुत किया है, जिसमें कार्यस्थल की ऐसी संस्कृति का वर्णन किया गया है जिसे दर्जनों वर्तमान और पूर्व कर्मचारियों ने उनके पद छोड़ने से पहले के महीनों में "विषाक्त, डराने वाली और अपमानजनक" बताया था।

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: श्रम विभाग के महानिरीक्षक कार्यालय द्वारा जारी यह रिपोर्ट महीनों लंबी उस जांच का समापन है, जो सचिव के कार्यालय के भीतर की स्थितियों के बारे में एक गुमनाम शिकायत प्राप्त होने के बाद शुरू हुई थी।

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: शावेज़-डेरेमर ने अप्रैल में अपने पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया था, और 44-पृष्ठों के निष्कर्ष इस सप्ताह केवल उन कांग्रेसी डेमोक्रेट्स के दबाव के बाद सार्वजनिक किए गए, जिन्होंने विभाग को इन्हें जारी करने के लिए मजबूर किया था।

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## जांच कैसे की गई

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, जांचकर्ताओं ने जांच के हिस्से के रूप में 53 वर्तमान और पूर्व श्रम विभाग के कर्मचारियों, साथ ही एक अन्य संघीय एजेंसी के एक कर्मचारी का साक्षात्कार लिया, और 500 से अधिक दस्तावेजों, छवियों और वीडियो की समीक्षा की, जिसमें निगरानी फुटेज भी शामिल है।

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: यह जांच कांग्रेस के एक पूर्व सदस्य के नेतृत्व में की गई, जो विभाग के भीतर निगरानी क्षमता में कार्यरत थे।

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: साक्षात्कार किए गए लोगों में से 38 ने सचिव के कार्यालय के भीतर के माहौल का वर्णन समान रूप से नकारात्मक शब्दों में किया, और जांचकर्ताओं को बताया कि प्रदर्शन समीक्षाओं पर कभी-कभी अन्य कर्मचारियों के सामने खुलकर चर्चा की जाती थी — जिसमें कुछ खातों के अनुसार, यह भी शामिल था कि क्या कर्मचारी बैठकों में रो पड़े थे।

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: गवाहों ने कहा कि इस माहौल ने "व्यापक भय और नौकरी की असुरक्षा" को बढ़ावा दिया, और कई कर्मचारियों ने बताया कि उन्हें नौकरी से निकालने की धमकी दी गई थी।

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## रिपोर्ट में क्या आरोप लगाए गए हैं

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ताओं का कहना है कि सबूत कई अलग-अलग क्षेत्रों में कदाचार की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, शावेज़-डेरेमर पर निम्नलिखित आरोप हैं:

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - विभाग के भीतर शत्रुतापूर्ण कार्य वातावरण में योगदान दिया

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - अपनी सुरक्षा टीम के एक सदस्य के साथ अनुचित संबंध बनाए

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - स्थापित संघीय यात्रा नियमों का पालन करने में विफल रहीं, जिसमें व्यक्तिगत यात्राओं के लिए सरकारी संसाधनों का उपयोग शामिल है

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - कई मौकों पर श्रम विभाग के कार्यालयों में या ड्यूटी के घंटों के दौरान शराब का सेवन किया

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - अधीनस्थों को अपने व्यक्तिगत लाभ के लिए कार्य करने का निर्देश दिया

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - विभाग के आवश्यक नैतिकता चैनलों के माध्यम से रिपोर्ट किए बिना उपहार स्वीकार किए

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: महानिरीक्षक कार्यालय ने कहा कि निष्कर्ष जांच के दौरान एकत्र की गई गवाहों की गवाही और दस्तावेजी सबूतों की अधिकता पर आधारित थे।

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: शावेज़-डेरेमर का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले एक वकील ने रिपोर्ट के निष्कर्षों को खारिज करते हुए कहा कि उन्होंने "किसी भी कानून का उल्लंघन नहीं किया" और उस अटकलबाजी की आलोचना की जिसे वकील ने निष्कर्ष सार्वजनिक होने से पहले प्रसारित समय से पहले की अटकलें बताया।

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: शावेज़-डेरेमर पर किसी भी अपराध का आरोप नहीं लगाया गया है, और OIG रिपोर्ट एक आपराधिक रेफरल के बजाय एक प्रशासनिक समीक्षा है।

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: श्रम विभाग ने निष्कर्षों से जुड़ी किसी भी आगे की अनुशासनात्मक या कानूनी कार्रवाई की घोषणा नहीं की है।

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: यह स्पष्ट नहीं है कि क्या रिपोर्ट को समीक्षा के लिए किसी अतिरिक्त निगरानी निकाय को भेजा जाएगा।

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## यह क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: यह प्रकरण शावेज़-डेरेमर के कार्यकाल के दौरान विभाग में सामने आए कर्मियों के विवादों की एक श्रृंखला में जुड़ गया है, जिसमें उसी आंतरिक जांच के बीच दो शीर्ष सहयोगियों का पहले का प्रस्थान भी शामिल है।

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: सदन और सीनेट श्रम समितियों के सांसदों ने संकेत दिया है कि वे रिपोर्ट के निष्कर्षों पर अतिरिक्त ब्रीफिंग की मांग कर सकते हैं, और सरकारी वॉचडॉग समूहों ने इस मामले को इस बात की परीक्षा के रूप में इंगित किया है कि कार्यकारी एजेंसियां अपने स्वयं के नेतृत्व के खिलाफ कदाचार की शिकायतों को कैसे संभालती हैं।

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, यह रिपोर्ट एक औपचारिक, हालांकि विलंबित, लेखा-जोखा है कि जांचकर्ताओं का क्या कहना है कि सरकार की सबसे बड़ी एजेंसियों में से एक में बंद दरवाजों के पीछे क्या हुआ था — और एक अनुस्मारक है कि महानिरीक्षक कार्यालय, चाहे वे कितने भी धीमे क्यों न हों, कैबिनेट-स्तरीय अधिकारी कार्यालय में अपना आचरण कैसे करते हैं, इस पर कुछ आंतरिक जांचों में से एक बने हुए हैं।

es.title: 53 entrevistas, un veredicto tóxico: lo que reveló el informe de supervisión sobre la exsecretaria de Trabajo Chavez-DeRemer

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: Un informe de supervisión largamente esperado ha presentado un relato detallado de las acusaciones de mala conducta contra la exsecretaria de Trabajo Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describiendo una cultura laboral que decenas de empleados actuales y antiguos calificaron de "tóxica, intimidante y humillante" en los meses previos a su renuncia.

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: El informe, publicado por la Oficina del Inspector General del Departamento de Trabajo, concluye una investigación de meses que comenzó después de que la OIG recibiera una queja anónima sobre las condiciones dentro de la oficina de la secretaria.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer renunció a su cargo en abril, y los hallazgos de 44 páginas solo se hicieron públicos esta semana tras la presión de los demócratas del Congreso, quienes habían instado al departamento a publicarlos.

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## Cómo se llevó a cabo la investigación

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: Según el informe, los investigadores entrevistaron a 53 empleados actuales y antiguos del Departamento de Trabajo, junto con un miembro del personal de otra agencia federal, y revisaron más de 500 documentos, imágenes y videos, incluyendo grabaciones de vigilancia, como parte de la indagación.

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: La investigación fue dirigida por un exmiembro del Congreso que desempeña funciones de supervisión dentro del departamento.

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: De los entrevistados, 38 describieron la atmósfera dentro de la oficina de la secretaria en términos igualmente negativos, diciendo a los investigadores que las evaluaciones de desempeño a veces se discutían abiertamente frente a otros miembros del personal, incluyendo, según algunos relatos, si los empleados habían sido reducidos a lágrimas en las reuniones.

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: Los testigos dijeron que el entorno fomentaba "un miedo generalizado y una inseguridad laboral", y varios empleados informaron que habían sido amenazados con el despido.

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## Lo que alega el informe

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: Los investigadores dicen que la evidencia apuntaba a una mala conducta en varias áreas distintas.

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: Según el informe, se alega que Chavez-DeRemer:

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - Contribuyó a un entorno laboral hostil dentro del departamento

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - Mantuvo una relación inapropiada con un miembro de su equipo de seguridad

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - No cumplió con las regulaciones federales de viaje establecidas, incluido el uso de recursos gubernamentales para viajes personales

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - Consumió alcohol en las oficinas del Departamento de Trabajo o durante el horario laboral en múltiples ocasiones

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - Ordenó a sus subordinados realizar tareas para su beneficio personal

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - Aceptó regalos sin informarlos a través de los canales de ética requeridos por el departamento

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: La oficina del Inspector General dijo que los hallazgos se basaron en la preponderancia del testimonio de los testigos y la evidencia documental reunida durante el transcurso de la investigación.

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## La respuesta

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: Un abogado que representa a Chavez-DeRemer rechazó las conclusiones del informe, diciendo que ella "no violó ninguna ley" y criticando lo que el abogado describió como especulaciones prematuras que habían circulado antes de que los hallazgos se hicieran públicos.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer no ha sido acusada de ningún delito, y el informe de la OIG es una revisión administrativa en lugar de una remisión penal.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: El Departamento de Trabajo no ha anunciado ninguna acción disciplinaria o legal adicional vinculada a los hallazgos.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: Sigue sin estar claro si el informe será remitido a algún organismo de supervisión adicional para su revisión.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: El episodio se suma a una serie de controversias de personal que surgieron en el departamento durante el mandato de Chavez-DeRemer, incluidas las salidas anteriores de dos altos asesores en medio de la misma investigación interna.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: Los legisladores de los comités de trabajo de la Cámara y el Senado han señalado que podrían solicitar sesiones informativas adicionales sobre los hallazgos del informe, y los grupos de vigilancia gubernamental han señalado el caso como una prueba de cómo las agencias ejecutivas manejan las quejas de mala conducta contra su propia dirección.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el informe se erige como una rendición de cuentas formal, aunque tardía, de lo que los investigadores dicen que sucedió a puerta cerrada en una de las agencias más grandes del gobierno, y un recordatorio de que las oficinas del inspector general, por muy lentas que sean, siguen siendo uno de los pocos controles internos sobre cómo los funcionarios de nivel de gabinete se comportan en el cargo.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا هذا مهم

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: تضاف هذه الحلقة إلى سلسلة من الخلافات المتعلقة بالموظفين التي ظهرت في الوزارة خلال فترة تولي شافيز-ديريمير، بما في ذلك المغادرة السابقة لمساعدين رئيسيين وسط نفس التحقيق الداخلي.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: أشار مشرعون في لجان العمل بمجلسي النواب والشيوخ إلى أنهم قد يسعون للحصول على إحاطات إضافية حول نتائج التقرير، وأشارت مجموعات الرقابة الحكومية إلى القضية باعتبارها اختباراً لكيفية تتعامل الوكالات التنفيذية مع شكاوى سوء السلوك ضد قيادتها الخاصة.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يقف التقرير كحساب رسمي، وإن كان متأخراً، لما يقول المحققون إنه حدث خلف الأبواب المغلقة في إحدى أكبر وكالات الحكومة - وتذكير بأن مكاتب المفتش العام، بغض النظر عن بطئها، تظل واحدة من الضوابط الداخلية القليلة حول كيفية تصرف مسؤولي مستوى مجلس الوزراء في مناصبهم.

fr.title: 53 entretiens, un verdict toxique : ce qu'a révélé le rapport du chien de garde sur l'ancienne secrétaire au Travail Chavez-DeRemer

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: Un rapport de surveillance tant attendu a exposé un compte rendu détaillé des allégations d'inconduite contre l'ancienne secrétaire au Travail Lori Chavez-DeRemer, décrivant une culture de travail que des dizaines d'employés actuels et anciens ont qualifiée de « toxique, intimidante et humiliante » dans les mois précédant son départ.

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: Le rapport, publié par le Bureau de l'inspecteur général du département du Travail, couronne une enquête de plusieurs mois qui a débuté après que l'OIG a reçu une plainte anonyme concernant les conditions au sein du bureau de la secrétaire.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer a démissionné de son poste en avril, et les conclusions de 44 pages n'ont été rendues publiques cette semaine qu'à la suite de la pression exercée par les démocrates du Congrès qui avaient poussé le département à les publier.

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## Comment l'enquête a été menée

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: Selon le rapport, les enquêteurs ont interrogé 53 employés actuels et anciens du département du Travail, ainsi qu'un membre du personnel d'une autre agence fédérale, et ont examiné plus de 500 documents, images et vidéos, y compris des images de surveillance, dans le cadre de l'enquête.

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: L'enquête a été menée par un ancien membre du Congrès exerçant des fonctions de surveillance au sein du département.

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: Parmi les personnes interrogées, 38 ont décrit l'atmosphère au sein du bureau de la secrétaire en termes tout aussi négatifs, affirmant aux enquêteurs que les évaluations de performance étaient parfois discutées ouvertement devant d'autres membres du personnel — y compris, selon certains témoignages, le fait que des employés aient fondu en larmes lors de réunions.

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: Les témoins ont déclaré que l'environnement favorisait « une peur généralisée et une insécurité de l'emploi », plusieurs employés signalant qu'ils avaient été menacés de licenciement.

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## Ce que prétend le rapport

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs affirment que les preuves pointent vers une inconduite dans plusieurs domaines distincts.

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: Selon le rapport, Chavez-DeRemer aurait :

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - Contribué à un environnement de travail hostile au sein du département

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - Noué une relation inappropriée avec un membre de son service de sécurité

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - Manqué de se conformer aux réglementations fédérales établies en matière de voyages, notamment par l'utilisation de ressources gouvernementales pour des voyages personnels

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - Consommé de l'alcool dans les bureaux du département du Travail ou pendant les heures de service à plusieurs reprises

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - Donné des instructions à des subordonnés pour effectuer des tâches à son profit personnel

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - Accepté des cadeaux sans les déclarer par le biais des canaux éthiques requis par le département

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: Le bureau de l'inspecteur général a déclaré que les conclusions étaient basées sur une prépondérance de témoignages de témoins et de preuves documentaires recueillies au cours de l'enquête.

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## La réponse

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: Un avocat représentant Chavez-DeRemer a rejeté les conclusions du rapport, affirmant qu'elle « n'a enfreint aucune loi » et critiquant ce que l'avocat a décrit comme des spéculations prématurées qui avaient circulé avant que les conclusions ne soient rendues publiques.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer n'a été inculpée d'aucun crime, et le rapport de l'OIG est un examen administratif plutôt qu'un renvoi criminel.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: Le département du Travail n'a annoncé aucune autre mesure disciplinaire ou légale liée aux conclusions.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: Il reste à savoir si le rapport sera renvoyé à un autre organisme de surveillance pour examen.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi c'est important

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: Cet épisode s'ajoute à une série de controverses sur le personnel qui ont fait surface au département pendant le mandat de Chavez-DeRemer, y compris les départs précédents de deux principaux collaborateurs au milieu de la même enquête interne.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: Les législateurs des comités du travail de la Chambre et du Sénat ont indiqué qu'ils pourraient demander des briefings supplémentaires sur les conclusions du rapport, et des groupes de surveillance gouvernementaux ont désigné cette affaire comme un test de la manière dont les agences exécutives gèrent les plaintes pour inconduite à l'encontre de leur propre direction.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le rapport constitue un compte rendu officiel, bien que tardif, de ce qui, selon les enquêteurs, s'est déroulé à huis clos dans l'une des plus grandes agences du gouvernement — et un rappel que les bureaux des inspecteurs généraux, aussi lents soient-ils, restent l'un des rares contrôles internes sur la manière dont les responsables au niveau du cabinet se comportent en fonction.

pt.title: 53 Entrevistas, um Veredito Tóxico: O que o Relatório de Fiscalização sobre a Ex-Secretária do Trabalho Chavez-DeRemer Revelou

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: Um relatório de fiscalização aguardado há muito tempo apresentou um relato detalhado de alegações de má conduta contra a ex-secretária do Trabalho Lori Chavez-DeRemer, descrevendo uma cultura de trabalho que dezenas de funcionários atuais e antigos chamaram de "tóxica, intimidadora e humilhante" nos meses anteriores à sua renúncia.

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: O relatório, divulgado pelo Gabinete do Inspetor Geral do Departamento do Trabalho, encerra uma investigação de meses que começou depois que o OIG recebeu uma denúncia anônima sobre as condições dentro do gabinete da secretária.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer renunciou ao seu cargo em abril, e as conclusões de 44 páginas só foram tornadas públicas esta semana após pressão de democratas do Congresso que haviam pressionado o departamento a divulgá-las.

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## Como a Investigação Foi Conduzida

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: De acordo com o relatório, os investigadores entrevistaram 53 funcionários atuais e antigos do Departamento do Trabalho, juntamente com um funcionário de outra agência federal, e analisaram mais de 500 documentos, imagens e vídeos, incluindo imagens de vigilância, como parte da apuração.

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: A investigação foi liderada por um ex-membro do Congresso que atuava em uma capacidade de supervisão dentro do departamento.

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: Dos entrevistados, 38 descreveram a atmosfera dentro do gabinete da secretária em termos igualmente negativos, dizendo aos investigadores que as avaliações de desempenho eram às vezes discutidas abertamente na frente de outros funcionários — incluindo, em alguns relatos, se os funcionários haviam sido levados às lágrimas em reuniões.

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: Testemunhas disseram que o ambiente promovia "medo generalizado e insegurança no trabalho", com vários funcionários relatando que haviam sido ameaçados de demissão.

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## O que o Relatório Alega

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: Os investigadores dizem que as evidências apontaram para má conduta em várias áreas distintas.

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: Segundo o relatório, alega-se que Chavez-DeRemer:

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - Contribuiu para um ambiente de trabalho hostil dentro do departamento

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - Envolveu-se em um relacionamento inadequado com um membro de sua equipe de segurança

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - Deixou de cumprir os regulamentos federais de viagem estabelecidos, incluindo o uso de recursos governamentais para viagens pessoais

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - Consumiu álcool em escritórios do Departamento do Trabalho ou durante o horário de serviço em várias ocasiões

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - Ordenou que subordinados realizassem tarefas para seu benefício pessoal

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - Aceitou presentes sem relatá-los através dos canais de ética exigidos pelo departamento

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: O gabinete do Inspetor Geral disse que as conclusões foram baseadas na preponderância de depoimentos de testemunhas e evidências documentais reunidas ao longo da investigação.

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## A Resposta

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: Um advogado que representa Chavez-DeRemer contestou as conclusões do relatório, dizendo que ela "não violou nenhuma lei" e criticando o que o advogado descreveu como especulação prematura que circulou antes que as conclusões fossem tornadas públicas.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer não foi acusada de nenhum crime, e o relatório do OIG é uma revisão administrativa, e não um encaminhamento criminal.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: O Departamento do Trabalho não anunciou nenhuma outra ação disciplinar ou legal vinculada às conclusões.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Por que Isso Importa

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: O episódio soma-se a uma série de controvérsias de pessoal que surgiram no departamento durante o mandato de Chavez-DeRemer, incluindo as saídas anteriores de dois assessores de alto escalão em meio à mesma investigação interna.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: Legisladores nos comitês de trabalho da Câmara e do Senado sinalizaram que podem buscar briefings adicionais sobre as conclusões do relatório, e grupos de fiscalização governamental apontaram o caso como um teste de como as agências executivas lidam com denúncias de má conduta contra sua própria liderança.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o relatório permanece como uma prestação de contas formal, embora tardia, do que os investigadores dizem ter acontecido a portas fechadas em uma das maiores agências do governo — e um lembrete de que os gabinetes dos inspetores gerais, por mais lentos que sejam, continuam sendo um dos poucos controles internos sobre como os funcionários de nível ministerial se comportam no cargo.

in.title: 53 Wawancara, Satu Putusan Beracun: Temuan Laporan Pengawas tentang Mantan Menteri Tenaga Kerja Chavez-DeRemer

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: Sebuah laporan pengawas yang telah lama ditunggu-tunggu telah memaparkan catatan rinci tentang tuduhan pelanggaran terhadap mantan Menteri Tenaga Kerja Lori Chavez-DeRemer, menggambarkan budaya kerja yang oleh puluhan staf saat ini dan sebelumnya disebut "beracun, mengintimidasi, dan memalukan" pada bulan-bulan sebelum dia mundur.

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: Laporan tersebut, yang dirilis oleh Kantor Inspektur Jenderal Departemen Tenaga Kerja, menandai akhir dari investigasi berbulan-bulan yang dimulai setelah OIG menerima pengaduan anonim tentang kondisi di dalam kantor menteri.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya pada bulan April, dan temuan setebal 44 halaman tersebut baru dipublikasikan minggu ini menyusul tekanan dari para Demokrat kongres yang telah mendorong departemen untuk merilisnya.

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Investigasi Dilakukan

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: Menurut laporan tersebut, penyidik mewawancarai 53 karyawan Departemen Tenaga Kerja saat ini dan sebelumnya, bersama dengan satu staf dari lembaga federal lain, dan meninjau lebih dari 500 dokumen, gambar, dan video, termasuk rekaman pengawasan, sebagai bagian dari penyelidikan.

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: Penyelidikan ini dipimpin oleh mantan anggota Kongres yang bertugas dalam kapasitas pengawasan di dalam departemen.

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: Dari mereka yang diwawancarai, 38 orang menggambarkan suasana di dalam kantor menteri dengan istilah negatif yang serupa, memberi tahu penyidik bahwa penilaian kinerja terkadang dibahas secara terbuka di depan staf lain — termasuk, dalam beberapa laporan, apakah karyawan telah dibuat menangis dalam rapat.

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: Saksi mengatakan lingkungan tersebut memicu "ketakutan yang meluas dan ketidakamanan kerja," dengan beberapa karyawan melaporkan bahwa mereka telah diancam dengan pemecatan.

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dituduhkan dalam Laporan

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: Penyidik mengatakan bukti tersebut mengarah pada pelanggaran di beberapa bidang yang berbeda.

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: Menurut laporan tersebut, Chavez-DeRemer diduga telah:

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - Berkontribusi pada lingkungan kerja yang tidak bersahabat di dalam departemen

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - Terlibat dalam hubungan yang tidak pantas dengan anggota detail keamanannya

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - Gagal mematuhi peraturan perjalanan federal yang ditetapkan, termasuk penggunaan sumber daya pemerintah untuk perjalanan pribadi

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - Mengonsumsi alkohol di kantor Departemen Tenaga Kerja atau selama jam tugas pada beberapa kesempatan

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - Memerintahkan bawahannya untuk melakukan tugas-tugas untuk kepentingan pribadinya

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - Menerima hadiah tanpa melaporkannya melalui saluran etika departemen yang disyaratkan

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: Kantor Inspektur Jenderal mengatakan temuan tersebut didasarkan pada prevalensi kesaksian saksi dan bukti dokumenter yang dikumpulkan selama penyelidikan.

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## Tanggapan

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: Seorang pengacara yang mewakili Chavez-DeRemer menolak kesimpulan laporan tersebut, dengan mengatakan dia "tidak melanggar hukum apa pun" dan mengkritik apa yang digambarkan pengacara sebagai spekulasi prematur yang telah beredar sebelum temuan tersebut dipublikasikan.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer belum didakwa melakukan kejahatan apa pun, dan laporan OIG adalah tinjauan administratif, bukan rujukan pidana.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: Departemen Tenaga Kerja belum mengumumkan tindakan disipliner atau hukum lebih lanjut yang terkait dengan temuan tersebut.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: Masih belum jelas apakah laporan tersebut akan dirujuk ke badan pengawas tambahan untuk ditinjau.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Ini Penting

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.

ja.title: 53件のインタビューと1つの毒された評決：元労働長官チャベス＝デレマーに関する監視機関の報告書が明らかにしたこと

segments.src: A long-awaited watchdog report has laid out a detailed account of misconduct allegations against former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, describing a workplace culture that dozens of current and former staffers called "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" in the months before she stepped down.
segments.tr: 長年待たれていた監視機関の報告書は、ロリ・チャベス＝デレマー前労働長官に対する不正行為の申し立ての詳細を明らかにし、彼女が辞任する数ヶ月前の職場の雰囲気を、現職および元スタッフの何十人もの人々が「有害で、威圧的で、屈辱的である」と表現したと述べている。

segments.src: The report, released by the Department of Labor's Office of Inspector General, caps a months-long investigation that began after the OIG received an anonymous complaint about conditions inside the secretary's office.
segments.tr: 労働省の監査官室が発表したこの報告書は、長官室内の状況に関する匿名からの苦情をOIGが受け取った後に始まった数ヶ月に及ぶ調査の締めくくりとなるものだ。

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer resigned from her post in April, and the 44-page findings were only made public this week following pressure from congressional Democrats who had pushed the department to release them.
segments.tr: チャベス＝デレマー氏は4月に職を辞任し、44ページの調査結果は、省に対して公表を迫っていた民主党の議員たちからの圧力により、今週になってようやく一般に公開された。

segments.src: ## How the Investigation Was Conducted
segments.tr: ## 調査はどのように行われたか

segments.src: According to the report, investigators interviewed 53 current and former Labor Department employees, along with one staffer from another federal agency, and reviewed more than 500 documents, images and videos, including surveillance footage, as part of the inquiry.
segments.tr: 報告書によると、調査官は労働省の現職および元職員53人に加え、別の連邦機関のスタッフ1人にインタビューを行い、監視カメラの映像を含む500以上の文書、画像、ビデオを調査の一環として確認した。

segments.src: The probe was led by a former member of Congress serving in an oversight capacity within the department.
segments.tr: この調査は、省内で監視の役割を担う元国会議員が率いた。

segments.src: Of those interviewed, 38 described the atmosphere inside the secretary's office in similarly negative terms, telling investigators that performance reviews were sometimes discussed openly in front of other staff — including, in some accounts, whether employees had been reduced to tears in meetings.
segments.tr: インタビューを受けた人々のうち38人は、長官室内の雰囲気を同様に否定的な言葉で表現し、他のスタッフの前で業績評価について公然と議論されることがあったと調査官に語った。これには、会議で従業員が涙を流したかどうかも含まれていたという。

segments.src: Witnesses said the environment fostered "widespread fear and job insecurity," with several employees reporting they had been threatened with termination.
segments.tr: 証人らは、この環境が「広範囲にわたる恐怖と雇用の不安」を助長したと述べ、複数の従業員が解雇の脅しを受けたと報告している。

segments.src: ## What the Report Alleges
segments.tr: ## 報告書が主張すること

segments.src: Investigators say the evidence pointed to misconduct across several distinct areas.
segments.tr: 調査官は、証拠がいくつかの異なる分野における不正行為を指し示していると述べている。

segments.src: Per the report, Chavez-DeRemer is alleged to have:
segments.tr: 報告書によると、チャベス＝デレマー氏は以下の行為を行ったとされている：

segments.src: - Contributed to a hostile work environment within the department
segments.tr: - 省内における敵対的な労働環境の一因となった

segments.src: - Engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a member of her security detail
segments.tr: - 警護チームのメンバーと不適切な関係を持った

segments.src: - Failed to comply with established federal travel regulations, including use of government resources for personal trips
segments.tr: - 私的な旅行への政府資源の使用を含む、確立された連邦の旅行規定を遵守しなかった

segments.src: - Consumed alcohol in Labor Department offices or during duty hours on multiple occasions
segments.tr: - 労働省のオフィス内または勤務時間中に複数回アルコールを摂取した

segments.src: - Directed subordinates to carry out tasks for her personal benefit
segments.tr: - 部下に自身の私的な利益のためのタスクを実行するよう指示した

segments.src: - Accepted gifts without reporting them through the department's required ethics channels
segments.tr: - 省の要求する倫理チャネルを通じて報告することなく贈り物を受け取った

segments.src: The Inspector General's office said the findings were based on a preponderance of witness testimony and documentary evidence gathered over the course of the investigation.
segments.tr: 監査官室は、調査の過程で収集された証人の証言と文書証拠の優勢に基づいていると述べた。

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## 対応

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: チャベス＝デレマー氏を代理する弁護士は、彼女が「いかなる法律も違反していない」と述べ、調査結果が公開される前に出回っていた時期尚早な憶測であると弁護士が表現したものを批判し、報告書の結論に反発した。

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: チャベス＝デレマー氏は犯罪で起訴されておらず、OIGの報告書は刑事告発ではなく行政的見直しである。

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: 労働省は、調査結果に結びついたさらなる懲戒処分や法的措置を発表していない。

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: この報告書が追加の監視機関にレビューのために回されるかどうかは依然として不透明である。

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## なぜそれが重要なのか

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: このエピソードは、チャベス＝デレマー氏の任期中に省内で表面化した一連の人事論争に加え、同じ内部調査の最中に行われた2人のトップ補佐官の早期の退任も含まれる。

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: 下院および上院の労働委員会の議員らは、報告書の調査結果に関する追加のブリーフィングを求める可能性があると示唆しており、政府の監視団体はこのケースを、執行機関が自らの指導部に対する不正行為の苦情をどのように処理するかの一つの試金石として指摘している。

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: 現時点では、この報告書は、政府最大の機関の一つで閉ざされたドアの後ろで何が起こったかについての調査官による、遅きに失したとはいえ公式な説明であり、監査官室がどれほど動きが遅くとも、閣僚級の役人が執務を行う上での数少ない内部牽制の一つであり続けることを思い出させるものである。

segments.src: ## The Response
segments.tr: ## Phản hồi

segments.src: An attorney representing Chavez-DeRemer pushed back on the report's conclusions, saying she "did not violate any law" and criticizing what the attorney described as premature speculation that had circulated before the findings were made public.
segments.tr: Một luật sư đại diện cho Chavez-DeRemer đã bác bỏ các kết luận của báo cáo, nói rằng bà "không vi phạm bất kỳ luật nào" và chỉ trích điều mà luật sư mô tả là sự suy đoán sớm đã lan truyền trước khi các phát hiện được công khai.

segments.src: Chavez-DeRemer has not been charged with any crime, and the OIG report is an administrative review rather than a criminal referral.
segments.tr: Chavez-DeRemer chưa bị buộc tội hình sự nào, và báo cáo của OIG là một đánh giá hành chính chứ không phải là một giấy chuyển hình sự.

segments.src: The Labor Department has not announced any further disciplinary or legal action tied to the findings.
segments.tr: Bộ Lao động chưa công bố bất kỳ hành động kỷ luật hoặc pháp lý nào gắn liền với các phát hiện.

segments.src: It remains unclear whether the report will be referred to any additional oversight body for review.
segments.tr: Vẫn chưa rõ liệu báo cáo có được chuyển cho bất kỳ cơ quan giám sát bổ sung nào để xem xét hay không.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao điều này quan trọng

segments.src: The episode adds to a string of personnel controversies that surfaced at the department during Chavez-DeRemer's tenure, including the earlier departures of two top aides amid the same internal investigation.
segments.tr: Sự việc này nối dài thêm một loạt tranh cãi về nhân sự nổi lên tại bộ trong nhiệm kỳ của Chavez-DeRemer, bao gồm việc ra đi trước đó của hai trợ lý cấp cao giữa cuộc điều tra nội bộ tương tự.

segments.src: Lawmakers on the House and Senate labor committees have signaled they may seek additional briefings on the report's findings, and government watchdog groups have pointed to the case as a test of how executive agencies handle misconduct complaints against their own leadership.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp tại các ủy ban lao động Hạ viện và Thượng viện đã ra hiệu rằng họ có thể tìm kiếm thêm các buổi briefings về các phát hiện của báo cáo, và các nhóm giám sát chính phủ đã chỉ ra vụ việc như một bài kiểm tra về cách các cơ quan hành pháp xử lý các khiếu nại sai phạm chống lại chính lãnh đạo của họ.

segments.src: For now, the report stands as a formal, if belated, accounting of what investigators say went on behind closed doors at one of the government's largest agencies — and a reminder that inspector general offices, however slow-moving, remain one of the few internal checks on how cabinet-level officials conduct themselves in office.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, báo cáo đứng vững như một bản tổng kết chính thức, dù là muộn màng, về những gì các điều tra viên cho biết đã diễn ra sau những cánh cửa đóng kín tại một trong những cơ quan lớn nhất của chính phủ — và là lời nhắc nhở rằng các văn phòng tổng thanh tra, dù chậm chạp đến đâu, vẫn là một trong số ít các cơ quan kiểm tra nội bộ đối với cách các quan chức cấp nội các hành xử trong văn phòng.
